scope_note: Per brief: parent will wire gate dispatcher, lanes.yaml, manifest schema. This file enumerates the deltas required.

manifest_schema_field_additions.rationale: Identity µservice declares its auth posture in machine-readable form so other µservices and lanes can introspect.

fields.name: oidc_acr_levels
fields.description: Per-µservice list of supported ACR class names; consumed by oya-check-step-up-auth-coverage and Cedar policy authoring.

fields.name: passkey_required
fields.description: True when at least one capability in this µservice REQUIRES Passkey authentication (vs allowing password+TOTP fallback).

fields.name: scim_provisioning_enabled
fields.description: True when this µservice exposes SCIM 2.0 inbound for enterprise IdP provisioning.

lanes_yaml_additions.rationale: Per ADR-0189 every mutating operation declares x-acr-required.

lanes_yaml_additions.scope: every .cedar file + every Envoy filter YAML
lanes_yaml_additions.rationale: Per ADR-0191 edge tier and origin tier never overlap.

lanes_yaml_additions.scope: every Cargo.toml dependency + Helm chart dep
lanes_yaml_additions.rationale: Per ADR-0187 §In-house roadmap, Zitadel-specific types live only in the adapter set.

out_of_scope_for_parent: All adapter implementations (Zitadel-specific) live in service-scoped IPs (003, 005, 008, 011); parent does NOT wire those.
